title: Generative Wavetable Libraries — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Generative Wavetable Libraries' rich face: the crystal table's one knob, walked up to what a single cycle keeps of the crystal; the Shepard table's brightness, counted; and the page's phase warning put to the crystal table with a blind test. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
grain: The page opens sections at ## only, and its claims sit under ###: Phase 1 and Phase 2 are both inside Plan, and What Requires Development inside Capability Assessment. So Plan is one section with one stamp and one approval for two pieces and a gathered sound; Capability Assessment is one with one piece and a gathered figure.

pieces.file: Generative Wavetable Libraries — rich — line up or not.html
pieces.near: sweeping a wavetable produces audible artifacts if frame phases are not aligned
pieces.title: line up or not · five steps
pieces.caption: **The phase warning, put to the crystal table.** Two of its frames crossfaded; one turned, so the raw middle thins; what carrying phase through does to this recipe (the fundamental is never detuned, so it never carries anything); the whole table swept three ways and read with the project's own meters; and last, a blind test, its rules set before the first trial, X balanced six and six. The warning holds on buzz: cycles turned to different starts, as arbitrary sources arrive, buzz 19 dB more than the shipped table. Their sag is 6.1 dB only on the raw blend; the table re-normalizes every frame, so as played the worst halfway blend is −1.0 dB and the sag shows instead as a level wobble of about ±3 dB. The page's open question barely matters here: carried phase is within 1.1 dB of buzz of zero-phase and changes only level, up to 2.8 dB frame by frame. The blind test matches level every 46 ms for that reason, and offers zero-phase against turned as the control a listener should pass. Measured by an agent; nobody has listened. Remade after the challenge.

pieces.title: the second frame-to-frame problem
pieces.caption: A second sweep artifact, found from Loudon's October buzz note and not yet in the text: on aligned frames, big jumps between neighbours flutter at the sweep's frame rate. Left, the buzz against a blur across neighbouring frames; right, one harmonic of the FM family chain as shipped and blurred. Measured by the steward (2026-10-28), not yet heard; its bullet for this section waits in the steward's tuning ledger for Loudon's review.

Relabel or replace it in the caption, step 4's text and table, and the prediction.

pieces.file: Generative Wavetable Libraries — rich — the crystal knob.html
pieces.near: Sweeping a wavetable position becomes a traversal through crystallographic symmetry space
pieces.title: the crystal knob · four steps
pieces.caption: **The crystal table's one knob, walked up to what the cycle keeps.** One cycle read round; the seven systems and the four numbers that make each; the knob through all 64 frames; and the test, its rule set first: does the detune that stands for broken symmetry reach the stored cycle at all? Detune on against off in the same recipe, with cubic as the control that must read nothing. It does reach it, and only as harmonic shape: −43.9 dB of the cycle's shape at hexagonal to −16.2 dB at triclinic, as a loop seam up to 12.3× the cycle's sharpest step. The inharmonic ringing it stands for can't be stored: a cycle read round has only whole-number harmonics, an identity proved on the Wavetable Oscillator page. The engine rebuilds crystal_bravais.wav sample for sample. Remade after the challenge.

pieces.file: Generative Wavetable Libraries — rich — brighter all the way.html
pieces.near: One note brightens monotonically as the position sweeps
pieces.title: brighter all the way · four steps
pieces.caption: **The sentence, counted.** One frame's brightness; the bell slid by the knob; one note swept the whole way; and the test, with its rule set first (one fall refutes it): 0 falls in the shipped table's 63 steps, 0 in the shipped audition's 507 windows, 0 in this page's engine, and a shuffled control that finds dozens, so the counter can fail. Where it stops: read without band-limiting, the top partial folds back from 86 Hz up (at A2 to 15.94 kHz, −9.6 dB of the sound late in the audition), and from A5 up the brightness steps back by under 0.002 octave. A band-limited reader keeps zero falls on every note.

pieces.near: One note brightens monotonically as the position sweeps
pieces.title: the audition Loudon accepted
pieces.caption: The steward's audition seed (2026-06-06): A2 held, the Shepard table swept from dark to bright in 12 s by the project's plain reader. Counted above, its brightness never falls. Late in the sweep there is a 15.94 kHz tone, the top octave folded back past Nyquist: −9.6 dB, about a tenth of the sound's energy, though high enough that many listeners won't hear it. A band-limited reader such as Serum's or Ableton's should drop it; that is expected behaviour, not checked.

verdicts.why: Step 4's 'held −109 dB' is the meter's floor, which any stored cycle reaches (a white-noise cycle scores the same), so the test can't fail, and the identity is already on Wavetable Oscillator's and Inharmonic Wavetable Synthesis's faces. State it as the identity, make the detune-on vs detune-off stored cycle (−16.2 dB, seam 12.3×) the level-matched test with its rule first, and fix check.py:95.

verdicts.why: A real count with its rule first and a control that fails (34/63, 277/507). My recount of the audition wav gives 0 falls at every window of 46 ms or more, and the 15.94 kHz fold-back and the A5/A6 falls reproduce.
Tracked, and the steward's own render. Caption note: 'faint' understates a tone carrying −9.6 dB of the sound's energy, and 'Serum and Ableton would drop' it is expected, not checked.

offers.challenge: confirmed in substance; the evidence is the project's own notes, not a measurement
offers.what: Phase 1 says the table synthesizes 'the combined phonon partial spectrum' and is 'the phonon dispersion parameter space made performable with a single knob' (page lines 131, 134). The project's own notes settle that it isn't: crystal-bravais/BUILD.md:33 says 'not a physically rigorous lattice/phonon model', and generate.py:19–23 calls it a deliberately simplified mapping from symmetry to timbre (partial count 3 to 36, roll-off, even-partial divisor, detune). Suggest the section say the knob sweeps partial count, roll-off and odd weight in order of falling point-group symmetry, a symmetry-to-timbre sketch, and keep 'traversal through crystallographic symmetry space', which holds as built. The piece adds only that the detune reaches the stored cycle as harmonic shape and a loop seam (−16.2 dB of triclinic's shape, seam up to 12.3×), never as inharmonic partials, which one cycle cannot hold ([[Wavetable Oscillator]]); those belong to [[Inharmonic Wavetable Synthesis]].

The answered question (zero-phase reset or carry phase through) could carry why it barely matters on the crystal table: the fundamental is never detuned, so it carries no phase, and only quiet upper partials drift. Carried against zero-phase: buzz −57.2 against −58.3 dB (the project's offnote_db, 6 s sweep at A2); raw sag −0.34 against −0.08 dB, and none as played. What carrying changes is per-frame level, up to 2.8 dB, through the per-frame peak scaling. Cycles that start at different points buzz 19.2 dB more (−39.1 dB). So for arbitrary source cycles the policy that matters is aligning start points, not carrying phase.

'Phase coherence across frames' holds as measured on the buzz: on the crystal table, cycles turned to different starts buzz 19.2 dB more than aligned ones. Their sag is about 1 dB as the table plays it (worst halfway blend −1.0 dB; −1.65 to +0.04 dB over 40 random draws), because generate.py re-normalizes every frame, so it shows as a level wobble of about ±3 dB. Crossfaded raw, as a reader crossfading stored cycles directly would play them, the sag is up to 6.1 dB (−3.2 to −7.8 dB over 40 draws). Not heard yet: the piece's blind test is waiting on a listener. The steward's proposed second bullet (smoothness along Position, tuning ledger item 2) sits beside this and is not this offer.
